title: Echo and Archive
author: Bram Blackwood
blurb: Orsen Dunmore, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
